items.title: Majority of states now battling Dollar General over pricing practices
items.zh_title: 多数州正就定价问题与 Dollar General 对簿公堂
items.zh_oneliner: 多个州指控 Dollar General 定价违规，零售商面临的监管压力持续加大。
items.en_oneliner: Multiple states are challenging Dollar General over its pricing practices, adding to regulatory pressure on the retailer.

items.title: Amazon enlists customers in fight against NYC delivery worker bill
items.zh_title: 亚马逊动员消费者反对纽约市配送员权益法案
items.zh_oneliner: 亚马逊号召顾客发声，反对纽约市一项旨在加强配送员权益保护的法案。
items.en_oneliner: Amazon is mobilizing customers to oppose a New York City bill aimed at strengthening protections for delivery workers.

items.title: Best Buy taps AI platform for supplier insights
items.zh_title: 百思买引入 AI 平台洞察供应商表现
items.zh_oneliner: 百思买用 AI 平台分析供应商数据，优化采购与补货决策。
items.en_oneliner: Best Buy is using an AI platform to analyze supplier data and sharpen purchasing and replenishment decisions.

items.title: Delivery Promise Gap? Investigate Before Raising Ad Spend
items.zh_title: 配送承诺有落差？先查清再加广告预算
items.zh_oneliner: 广告花钱前先核对实际配送时效，承诺与履约的落差会直接拖累转化。
items.en_oneliner: Check actual delivery times before raising ad spend — a gap between promise and fulfillment drags down conversion.
